title: 3 things I learned while my plane crashed
speaker: Ric Elias

sentences.en: Life was over. Now I want to share with you three things I learned about myself that day.

sentences.en: I learned that it all changes in an instant.
sentences.zh: 和你们分享那天我对自己学到的三件事：我明白 一切都会在

sentences.en: We have this bucket list, we have these things we want to do in life, and I thought about all the people I wanted to reach out to that I didn't, all the fences I wanted to mend, all the experiences I wanted to have and I never did.
sentences.zh: 一切都会在 瞬间改变。我们都有愿望清单，我们有很多 想做的事情。 在生活中，我 想到了所有我想 联系却没联系的人，所有我 想跨越的藩篱，所有我 想体验却从未实现的经历。

sentences.en: As I thought about that later on, I came up with a saying, which is, "I collect bad wines."

sentences.en: Because if the wine is ready and the person is there, I'm opening it.

sentences.en: And that urgency, that purpose, has really changed my life.

sentences.en: The second thing I learned that day -- and this is as we clear the George Washington Bridge, which was by not a lot -- (Laughter) I thought about, wow, I really feel one real regret.
sentences.zh: 改变了我的 生活。那天我学到的第二件事，是在 我们驶过乔治· 华盛顿大桥的时候（其实没过多久）， 我突然意识到，我真的感到 一个深深的遗憾。我努力在人性中活出精彩的人生，也承认自己犯

sentences.en: I've lived a good life. In my own humanity and mistakes, I've tried to get better at everything I tried.

sentences.en: But in my humanity, I also allow my ego to get in.

sentences.en: And I regretted the time I wasted on things that did not matter with people that matter.
sentences.zh: 我也允许自己的 自负蒙蔽了双眼。我后悔当时把时间 浪费在无关紧要的事情上，浪费在了重要的人和事上。

sentences.en: And I thought about my relationship with my wife, with my friends, with people.
sentences.zh: 我想起了我和 妻子、朋友以及其他所有人的关系。

sentences.en: And after, as I reflected on that, I decided to eliminate negative energy from my life.

sentences.en: I've not had a fight with my wife in two years.

sentences.zh: 选择 快乐。我学到的第三件事，就是当 你的脑海里倒计时到 15、14、13，你能看到水

sentences.en: You can see the water coming. I'm saying, "Please blow up."

sentences.zh: 块。 当我们下降的时候，我突然 意识到，哇，死亡并不可怕，

sentences.zh: 念头：我只希望一 件事，那就是看着我的孩子们

sentences.en: And it made all the sense in the world to me.

sentences.en: I challenge you guys that are flying today, imagine the same thing happens on your plane -- and please don't -- but imagine, and how would you change?
sentences.zh: 不同的方式重生。我向 今天乘坐飞机的各位发出挑战：想象一下，同样的事情 发生在你们的飞机上——请不要真的去想，但请 想象一下——你们会如何改变？

sentences.en: What would you get done that you're waiting to get done because you think you'll be here forever?
sentences.zh: 想象一下——你们会如何改变？ 你们会完成哪些 因为觉得 自己会永远活下去而一直拖延的事情？你们会如何

sentences.en: How would you change your relationships and the negative energy in them?
sentences.zh: 自己会永远活下去而一直拖延的事情？你们会如何 改变你们的人际关系，以及 其中的负能量？最重要的是，

sentences.en: And more than anything, are you being the best parent you can?
